def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the uniform divider between the two equal panels.
    if w % 2 == 1 and all(len(row) == w for row in grid) and len({row[w // 2] for row in grid}) == 1:
        k = w // 2
        left = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        right = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
    elif h % 2 == 1 and len(set(grid[h // 2])) == 1:
        k = h // 2
        left, right = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
    else:
        raise ValueError('No central uniform divider')
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    background = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == background and right[r][c] == background else background
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(len(left))]
